check_box.tool_tip: See a line connecting the camera focus point to the avatar. Useful to find where they are.

check_box.label: Enable RLV (RestrainedLove API)
check_box.tool_tip: RLV lets scripts in your worn attachments restrict and control your viewer (for example hide names, lock outfits or limit chat). Turning it off ignores all RLV commands. A notice tells you when the change takes effect; RLV that is already running may need a relog to fully switch off.
check_box.name: enable_rlv

panel.label: Discord
panel.name: privacy_preferences_discord
panel.panel.string: Discord status is not available in this build (no Discord application id is configured).
panel.text: Show that you're in Second Life on your Discord profile. Needs the Discord app running on this computer. Nothing is sent before you log in, and the status is cleared when you log out.

check_box.label: Enable Discord status
check_box.tool_tip: Show your Second Life status on your Discord profile (Discord Rich Presence)
check_box.name: discord_enabled

check_box.label: Show what I'm doing (standing, sitting, flying, away, busy)
check_box.name: discord_show_activity

check_box.label: Show my avatar name
check_box.tool_tip: Uses your display name / username settings. Hidden while RLVa restricts names.
check_box.name: discord_show_name

check_box.label: Show region
check_box.tool_tip: Show the region you're in. Hidden while RLVa restricts location.
check_box.name: discord_show_region

check_box.label: Show "Teleport to me" button
check_box.tool_tip: Adds a button to your Discord status that opens your location (SLURL) on the Second Life map. Needs Show region; Second Life main grid only. Discord doesn't show the button to you, only to others.
check_box.name: discord_show_join

check_box.label: Hide location in Moderate and Adult regions
check_box.tool_tip: Hide the region and the teleport button while you're in a Moderate or Adult region.
check_box.name: discord_hide_mature
